column1: # Mousset, Dépêches diplomatiques de M. de Longlée (Paris 1912), pp. lviii-lix, "Chiffre de Longlée reconstitué d'après l'interprétation de ses dépêches".
# Key source: published (Albert Mousset's modern reconstruction, credited). Read by D4-VIVMOUS, 6 Oct 2026, from IA dpchesdiplom00longuoft
# leaves n67 (p.lviii) and n68 (p.lix), page images at 1800 px; the _djvu.txt OCR of the table is unusable (glyphs). Glyphs are described
# in words; images: mousset1912_plviii_table.jpg, mousset1912_plix_w500.jpg. Order within a row is Mousset's left-to-right order (g1, g2, ...).
# Tomokiyo (henryiii.htm): Vivonne used this table from 1579 and left it to Longlée, so it applies to fr.16107 (1580).
